title: Madden 27 Ratings: Christian Gonzalez is NFL’s top-ranked CB in new game
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Christian Gonzalez is rated 98 overall, the highest for a cornerback in Madden 27.
Gonzalez is one of the five New England Patriots with top ratings in the new Madden game.
The official worldwide release date for Madden 27 is August 13, with early access available August 6.

title: Jeff Passan floats blockbuster trade for Red Sox and Marlins
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Red Sox are considering a trade with the Marlins for shortstop Otto Lopez and catcher Liam Hicks.
Otto Lopez and Liam Hicks provide strong offensive and defensive potential to bolster Boston's lineup.
The potential trade may require the Red Sox to give up prospects like Marcelo Mayer or Franklin Arias.

title: Death of woman, 18, found dead in Mattapan home owned by Pressley’s husband ruled a homicide
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Yoseliani Marte, 18, died from a gunshot wound in a Mattapan home owned by Ayanna Pressley's husband; ruled homicide.
Police have not made arrests or filed charges in the homicide; incident involved domestic violence, family states.
Pressley and husband are not linked to the crime; investigation by BPD Homicide Unit is ongoing.

title: Caleb Lomu is learning more than just right tackle at his first training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Caleb Lomu, a first-round pick, is practicing at multiple positions including right tackle, guard, and jumbo tight end.
Coach Mike Vrabel praises Lomu's versatility and quick learning during the New England Patriots' training camp.
Lomu believes learning different positions will enhance his skills and help secure a role on the team.

title: Kayshon Boutte addresses trade rumors, future with Patriots
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Kayshon Boutte acknowledges trade rumors but remains focused on his current role with the New England Patriots.
Head coach Mike Vrabel suggests a trade could be an option due to the Patriots' crowded wide receiver roster.
Boutte has been performing well in training camp despite rumors, maintaining strong chemistry with quarterback Drake Maye.

title: Man charged after allegedly shoving 69-year-old woman at Nantucket ICE protest
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Lee M. Kennedy, 62, charged with felony assault after allegedly shoving a woman at a Nantucket ICE protest.
Kennedy admitted to pushing the 69-year-old participant during the Indivisible Nantucket vigil on South Beach Street.
The incident occurred amid heavy pedestrian traffic; witnesses recorded Kennedy's actions, leading to his upcoming arraignment.

title: Critical Mass Boston to hold 15-mile bike ride in remembrance of cyclist struck and killed earlier this month
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Louisa Gag, a Boston transportation planner, was killed by a driver on Tremont Street on July 9, 2026.
Critical Mass Boston organizes a 15-mile bike ride on Friday to honor Louisa Gag and her bike safety contributions.
The ride advocates for bicycle safety policy changes, urging Mayor Wu to support the city Streets Cabinet effectively.

title: This iconic 150-year-old tree was coming down in Belmont. These birds said, not so fast.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A 150-year-old copper beech tree in Belmont's Town Green was set for removal due to disease.
Work was halted when a nest of federally protected American robin nestlings was discovered in the tree.
The tree's removal is postponed until the birds fledge, allowing residents more time to visit the landmark.

title: A.J. Brown finally gets going, and other takeaways from Day 5 of Patriots training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: A.J. Brown and Drake Maye showed improved connection during Patriots' first padded practice, enhancing the passing game.
Christian Gonzalez actively participated in full-contact drills despite ongoing contract negotiations, maintaining a strong defensive presence.
Kyle Williams stood out in practice, catching touchdowns from Tommy DeVito during 11-on-11 drills with the second team.

title: Child on bike injured in crash with SUV in Wellesley
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: A child on a bicycle was injured in a crash with an SUV at Oakland Street and Woodlawn Avenue, Wellesley.
The child was conscious and alert upon arrival of police and taken to a Boston hospital for evaluation.
The Wellesley Police Crash Reconstruction Unit is investigating; the SUV driver stayed at the scene of the accident.
